subject.title: EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError: session GC deletes file while agent is still running

question: Should this be fixed now as an active session-work/admission guard in cron/session cleanup, or folded into the broader cron retention and session-storage migration work?
rationale: The bug is concrete, but the durable repair crosses cron retention, active-work admissions, transcript archival, and broader storage migration policy, so maintainers should choose the owner boundary before another fix lane starts.

options.title: Add Active-Work Guard Now
options.body: Repair the reaper/cleanup path so active admitted cron runs cannot be archived while running, and leave broader key-shape/storage cleanup to existing trackers.

options.title: Fold Into Existing Trackers
options.body: Keep this issue linked to cron retention and SQLite storage work, accepting that the active-run failure remains open until the larger lifecycle change lands.

options.title: Temporarily Relax Ambiguous Pruning
options.body: Disable or loosen cleanup for ambiguous cron run entries until lifecycle ownership is explicit, reducing immediate risk at the cost of retained stale state.

recommendation.title: Add Active-Work Guard Now
recommendation.body: Repair the reaper/cleanup path so active admitted cron runs cannot be archived while running, and leave broader key-shape/storage cleanup to existing trackers.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current lifecycle cleanup seam and coordinate the storage migration boundary that this decision must not fight.
